title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 520  An Act Converting the Mactan Barangay High School in Barangay Mactan, Lapu-Lapu City, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Mactan National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Mactan Barangay tại Barangay Mactan, Thành phố Lapu-Lapu thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Mactan Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mactan Barangay ในบารังไกย์ Mactan เมือง Lapu-Lapu เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mactan แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Mactan Barangay di Barangay Mactan, Kota Lapu-Lapu menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Mactan Nasional

text.en:
The Mactan Barangay High School in Barangay Mactan, Lapu-lapu City, is converted into a
national high school to be known as the Mactan National High School.

The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports is directed to take such steps as are necessary for
the conversion and operation of the school and immediate implementation of this Act.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
